name: When is the best time to install a kitchen backsplash during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to install a kitchen backsplash during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to install a kitchen backsplash during a renovation is typically after countertops have been installed but before appliances are permanently set in place, especially if the backsplash extends behind them. This sequence ensures accurate measurements and avoids damage to new countertops. Installing the backsplash earlier allows for easier access and minimizes the risk of damaging other finished elements. It also allows time for the thin-set and grout to fully cure before the kitchen is put into heavy use. Hometelligent Inc. coordinates with other trades to ensure seamless integration into your overall renovation timeline.
acceptedAnswer.description: Install a kitchen backsplash after countertops are in but before permanent appliance placement. This prevents damage to new surfaces and allows for proper curing before heavy use.
